set.body: S5 execution slice: immutable cursor with named whole-study preparation and whole-trial sampling stages, preserving exact legacy point-sampling arithmetic, keys, rows, controls and results. Pair quanta bound trial keys; no intra-preparation or intra-trial cancellation promise. Shared Stepwise instance, pinned old result payload as independent oracle, stage/work/overflow/cancellation-boundary conformance and row-loss mutation. Family descriptor/schema/fs2/archive/table witness follows separately.
set.title: Add resumable point-sampling execution stages
